$comment: Example TikTok Content Posting API direct-post init payload (POST https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/post/publish/video/init/ with Authorization: Bearer <TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN>). After init, the video bytes are PUT to the returned upload_url with Content-Range headers, then status is polled at /v2/post/publish/status/fetch/.
